name: Q3 Executive Summary
prompt: I need a high-level executive summary for Q3 company performance. Give me a clean, simple layout with massive KPI cards for Total Revenue, Profit Margin, and Customer Acquisition Cost. Below that, just show one beautifully simple line chart tracking our growth against our Q3 target, and a small data table of our 3 biggest closing deals.

thought_process.interpretation: I have identified the persona as an Executive seeking a high-level strategic overview of Q3 performance. The goal is to monitor business health through specific financial KPIs and a growth trend comparison. I selected the 'Executive Summary' layout archetype, focusing on massive metric visibility and clean, high-contrast visualizations. A functional Q3 month-filter was added to ensure the dashboard remains interactive and allows for period-specific analysis.
assumed_from_scratch: Recharts implementation details for the dual-line growth vs. target chart
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A dedicated 'Filter Segment' component skill would be beneficial to standardize the styling and behavior of multi-option period selectors.
